what_it_is: Year-over-year % increase in revenue for each forecast year.

Terminal g raised 3.0%→3.5% (pricing > inflation). Mortgage wholesale royalty $4.95→$10.00 is near-100% incremental margin and lifts the near-term path vs MODEL13's 27/16/13/10/7.
source: Equifax / Hawley — FICO 2026 mortgage royalty 2x; EX-99.1 Q3 FY2026 guidance

what_it_is: Cost of revenues as a % of sales (gross margin = 1 − this).
how_set_in_model: Excel: MAX(10%, segment blended COGS base≈14.58% − 120bps × year).
why_this_choice: MODEL14 Yacktman: Branch Process MODEL13→MODEL14: COGS grind −120 bps/yr (was −75); SG&A −175 bps/yr (was −125); R&D −50 bps/yr (MODEL13 held R&D% flat). B2B / mortgage royalty price hikes have ~100% incremental GM and need ~0 incremental SG&A/R&D — ~95%+ of incremental Scores revenue flows to CFO. 2026 mortgage wholesale royalty 4.95→10.00 (Equifax/Hawley; industry uplift cited up to ~$500M). Mix % offset within Total Revenue (not a second revenue stack).
source: SEC 10-K FY2025 — Scores +$249M YoY 'primarily attributable to a higher unit price'

why_this_choice: Branch Process: MODEL13 used −125 bps / 15% floor; MODEL14 uses −175 bps / 14% floor — B2B Scores price hikes need ~0 incremental SG&A so ~95%+ drops to CFO.
source: SEC 10-K FY2025 — SG&A; Equifax/Hawley mortgage royalty 2x

source: SEC 10-K FY2025 — tax expense; cash taxes from IncomeTaxesPaidNet

what_it_is: Days Sales Outstanding. AR = Revenue × DSO / 365.
how_set_in_model: Yellow POLICY path: phases 97d (FY25 hist) → 35d over 5 years (Y1≈84.6d … Y5=35d). Segment blend ref ≈ 27.5d on schedule row 115 (SaaS 40/B2C 2/B2B 25/PS 12/On-prem 40).
why_this_choice: Branch Process vs MODEL13 (6.5/10): MODEL13 targeted 45d; MODEL14 targets 35d so cash is not trapped vs SaaS upfront / Scores settlement reality. Branch Process MODEL13→MODEL14: Operating NWC = AR+Inv−AP (excludes Deferred) unchanged in structure, but DSO fade accelerates — MODEL13 targeted 45d; MODEL14 targets 35d (hist 97d → 35d over 5yrs) so cash is not artificially trapped. Increase in Deferred Revenue remains an explicit CFO/FCFF source (row 81). AR and unearned revenue are never double-counted. Deferred Revenue stays in Total Liabilities and is an explicit +ΔDeferred in CFO/FCFF (not inside Op NWC). Forecast Deferred = Rev × (SaaS%+OnPrem%) × (FY25 Def/FY25 soft Rev). FY25 current deferred ≈ $187.4M. Q1 FY2026 roll-forward: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/814547/000081454726000011/R45.htm.
source: SEC 10-K FY2025 — AR; Q1 FY2026 deferred detail

what_it_is: New borrowing (+) or repayment (−) in the forecast ($000s).

source: SEC companyfacts — ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSeniorLongTermDebt / RepaymentsOfLinesOfCredit

what_it_is: New equity issued (+) or buybacks (−) in the forecast BS/CF.
how_set_in_model: Equation: −(CFO − CapEx) − DebtIssuance so residual levered FCF funds buybacks (hist 3yr avg buybacks ≈ $881M/yr).
why_this_choice: Restores financing realism so cash does not artificially stockpile. Buybacks are financing — excluded from FCFF. DCF share count FALLS with this buyback outflow. Starting shares = 21,597.635k (post–Q3 FY2026). Shares_t = Shares_t−1 + EquityCF_t / Price; EquityCF is buyback outflow (negative). Price policy $1,149 (= Q3 avg repurchase). source: SEC 10-K FY2025 — Repurchases of common stock ($1.415B); June 2025 $1B authorization
